title: Services Engagement Manager - ClinData
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
The Services Engagement Manager (SEM) is responsible for setting our customers up for success and representing the entire value proposition and effort behind a Veeva ClinData Implementation. This is a critical role in ensuring successful customer engagements during the scoping and planning phase to establish the right strategy for implementation success. The SEM is an integral part of the sales cycle, acting as a solution expert working in close alignment with the Veeva Sales, Strategy, and Services Teams.
Utilizing their own clinical trial systems experience and Veeva product knowledge, they will structure the right solution, set the right expectations, and identify the appropriate project charter, including staffing, timeframes, and associated costs. Delivery of Proposals and Statements of Work (SOW) is a key deliverable from the SEM, along with potential implementation partner recommendations and strategic alignment of the team prior to project start.
What You'll Do

• Align closely with services and sales teams to provide implementation proposals and establish confidence with prospects in our ability to deliver

• Set client and internal stakeholder expectations correctly with a focus on long-term success

• Provide awareness and alignment with the partner ecosystem

• Position support, training, and other solutions that may be needed for a successful customer experience

• Travel estimate: Less than 25%

Requirements

• 5+ years experience in delivering consulting services or involvement in selling services for Clinical Data Applications with a proven track record

• 2+ years of experience scoping/defining project plans, resource models, and negotiation of Statements of Work for software implementation projects

• Understanding of the data capture for the clinical trials domain, including how EDC works with IVRS, safety systems, CTMS and downstream databases, and eCOA

• Familiarity in working with the Life Sciences Industry

• Ability to engage audiences of varying perception levels, including working with executive leadership

• Strong negotiation skills

• Collaborative and consultative work style

• Works well under pressure and with short or competing timelines

• Ability to travel

Nice to Have

• Experience in interpreting clinical protocols

• SaaS/Cloud experience in the delivery

Interviewing with Veeva

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

title: Oncology Field Medical Director, Thoracic (non-MD)
description:
Lung cancer treatment is evolving rapidly, and the space between emerging evidence and every day clinical practice is where our medical expertise matters most.

As a field-based scientific expert supporting Pfizer ’s Thoracic oncology portfolio in Michigan and Ohio (MI/OH)., you will engage a broad range of medical customer segments. You will deliver approved medical and scientific education to healthcare professionals, surface insights that inform medical strategy, support the identification of potential clinical trial sites and clinical trial support, and help address the field’s most important unanswered scientific questions in service of improving patient outcomes.

Field Medical Core Responsibilities

• Plan and execute Medical strategy and engagement for appropriate assigned customers within a territory, compliantly coordinating with other Pfizer colleagues as needed to achieve Medical objectives

• Maintain required level of knowledge of relevant TA/disease states and Pfizer medicines, providing therapeutic area/product information to both internal and external stakeholders as needed

• Serve as a conduit and resource for Medical Information and customer insights, providing requested information to HCPs as allowed by Pfizer guidance and sharing customer viewpoints with Pfizer as appropriate

• Understand the priorities of Pfizer Medical Affairs in order to contribute to Medical content strategy development and execute aligned Field Medical tactics

• Maintain effective and appropriate communication and collaboration among headquarters Medical colleagues, Medical Information, and other Pfizer Field Medical colleagues

• Demonstrate expertise in communication across multiple channels, including, but not limited to, live and virtual presentations in small or large settings, written communication, and telephone or virtual conversations

• Optimize patient centricity of Medical communications and deliverables, incorporating Health Literacy and cultural awareness principles to ensure that patients remain the ultimate focus

Field Medical: Additional Responsibilities

• Deliver approved medical content about Pfizer medicines and relevant topics in the designated therapeutic area.

• Identify and seek medical engagement from priority customer segments in assigned Therapeutic Area.

• Provide truthful, accurate, and scientifically supported information in response to direct unsolicited medical requests from HCPs in a manner that complies with all applicable Pfizer guidelines, policies, and procedures.

• Leads advisory boards, working with vendors if necessary, with manager oversight.

• Field relevant inbound queries from HCPs via established triage process.

• In collaboration with Global Medical Affairs colleagues, partner with Oncology Research & Development and Global Product Development (GPD) in the identification of potential sites for Pfizer -sponsored clinical trials, including identification of sites serving under-represented patient populations in trials.

• Appropriately provide Medical support throughout the Investigator Sponsored Research (ISR) process.

• Cultivate research and therapeutic area expertise, including familiarity with latest congress data and disease state literature.

• Provides Asset leadership.

• Understand the principles of study design, methodology, data analysis, and interpretation and communicate these concepts with customers.

• Lead your territory with an ownership mindset: strategic planning, disciplined prioritization, and full accountability for medical impact in your geography.

• Reactively and proactively communicate with local Patient Advocacy Group(s), as appropriate, in close collaboration with Corporate Affairs and HQ Medical Affairs.

• Deliver actionable field insights - local patient organization structure, capabilities, patient population needs, real-world treatment patterns, evolving standards of care, and unmet data needs - to inform medical strategy and evidence generation.

description:
- This employment opportunity is through Delfina Medical Group -
Objective: Delfina Medical Group is hiring a full-time, Spanish and English based bilingual Registered Dietitian and Lactation Consultant to support patients through pregnancy and postpartum. This is a 100% virtual position. The role combines direct patient care with building and maintaining clinical protocols, and grows over time to include additional state licensure and support for other dietitians as the team expands.
About Us: Delfina Medical Group and Delfina Care Inc. provide a leading pregnancy care data platform and clinical services to improve maternal and child health outcomes.
‍ About You: We are looking for a clinician who is passionate about patient engagement in nutrition, lactation, and lifestyle, and who is comfortable using technology to support better care. This is a combined role for someone who holds both Registered Dietitian and IBCLC credentials.

A) Nutrition and Lactation Care

• Provide perinatal nutrition and lactation care for pregnancy and postpartum.

• Provide 1:1 and group dietitian and and lactation visits by video, phone, and app.

• Manage nutrition care for the pregnancy and postpartum journey including gestational diabetes and for Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes in pregnancy.

• Teach and lead group lactation support and education classes.

• Create breastfeeding and chestfeeding protocols and safety measures for a telemedicine platform.

B) Protocols and Patient Content

• Build and maintain nutrition and lactation protocols and safety measures for virtual care.

• Update protocols and procedures as needed to keep care safe and effective.

• Create app-based patient content that supports learning and success.

C) Growth and Team Support

• Obtain additional state dietitian licenses over time to support patients as Delfina expands into new states.

• As the dietitian team grows, help support and guide other Registered Dietitians and Lactation Consultants within Delfina Medical Group.

• Registered Dietitian (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) with at least a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.

• Active International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC).

• Licensed to practice as a dietitian in at least three of the following states:

• Maryland

• Nevada

• Illinois

• Texas

• Willing to obtain additional state licenses.

• Fluent in English and Spanish. This is required.

• Two or more years providing pregnancy-related nutrition care, including management of gestational diabetes and Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes.

• CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) certification, or the clinical experience to be CDCES-eligible(Preferred)

• One or more years of experience practicing as an IBCLC in the prenatal and postpartum setting.

• Previous experience providing virtual patient care.

Virtual Work Requirements

• A private location with reliable high-speed internet suitable for patient visits.

• Comfort working by video, phone, text, and app-based tools.

Compensation and Benefits

• Full-time, salaried position (or part-time upon interest).

• Health insurance benefits.

• Starter 401(k) plan available for employee contributions (non-matching).

• Support for maintaining multi-state licensure.

We value that everyone at Delfina brings a unique background and perspective. title: Vocational Education Program Consultant (1099)
description:
DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change. Through innovative programs, relevant partnerships, and exceptional care, we empower students to meaningfully improve their lives, communities, and workplaces.
Our colleague experience is an area of obsessive focus. At DeVry University , we care about you. Because, only through you can we deliver our unique Care Formula to our learners and partners.
DeVry University is evaluating opportunities to expand its workforce-aligned education portfolio and is seeking an experienced vocational education leader to advise Product, Strategy, and Academics. Initial work will focus on assessing the feasibility of a potential electrical technician/electrician-focused program and developing recommendations related to market demand, program design, delivery model, operating requirements, and financial viability. Subject to the outcome of the feasibility assessment and institutional approval, the engagement may extend into detailed program design and launch planning. This is a hands-on advisory engagement for someone who has personally designed, launched, and scaled comparable programs and who understands both the academic architecture and operating economics of running one. The selected consultant will assess industry standards, licensure pathways, and employer demand and develop recommendations for a potential program designed to prepare graduates for relevant entry-level employment, apprenticeship opportunities, and, where applicable, future licensure requirements. Key Responsibilities Business Case and Market Validation

• Partner with Product and Strategy to develop the business case, including labor-market demand, wage outcomes, competitive landscape, potential physical lab investments, site considerations, enrollment potential, and unit economics.

• Distinguish clearly between validated market facts, working assumptions, and recommendations to support an informed leadership go/no-go decision.

• Advise on potential pricing, cohort sizing, delivery models, including hybrid lab and online theory, and the capital and staffing considerations associated with hands-on instruction.

Program and Curriculum Design

• Develop recommendations to inform a potential program's competency framework, course sequence, clock- or credit-hour structure, and lab and equipment requirements.

• Assess alignment with recognized industry standards, including the National Electrical Code (NEC/NFPA 70), NCCER Core and Electrical curricula, OSHA 10/30, and relevant state licensure and U.S. Department of Labor Registered Apprenticeship requirements.

• Develop recommendations for potential articulation pathways into apprenticeships and journey-level opportunities, including opportunities associated with IBEW/NECA and other union or independent-contractor pathways, where applicable.

Industry and Employer Alignment

• Advise on the potential development of an employer or industry advisory board to help ensure program recommendations reflect current field practices and hiring needs.

The ways customers buy from us are multiplying as fast as the business is growing. Enterprise order forms. Private offers through AWS, GCP, and Azure. A self-serve business running on usage-based pricing, with commits, drawdowns, and true-ups behind it. Each one is a distinct path from signature to cash, and each one runs today on some mix of manual steps and automation that grew up with the business.

Every new channel launches against defined readiness criteria, so marketplace deals run on the same clean path as direct ones

- Own self-serve billing operations: usage metering, plan changes, dunning, credits, rebills, refunds, and the escalations behind them

title: Model Policy Manager, National Security
description:
About the Team

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models, ensuring our models are deployed responsibly and have a positive impact on society. Our work spans diverse research and engineering initiatives-from system-level safeguards and model training to evaluation and red-teaming-all aimed at mitigating misuse, misalignment, and maintaining our high bar for safety. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency. Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations.

Within Safety Systems, the Model Policy team works to ensure that frontier models behave safely and reliably in real-world environments by designing policies that define safe model behavior.

We've had several relevant publications, including:

- Safety at every step https://openai.com/safety/

- OpenAI GPT6 System Card https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-6-astra

- OpenAI Model Spec https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-model-spec/

About the Role

We’re hiring a Model Policy Manager to shape model behavior for U.S. government use, with a focus on national security applications. You’ll define nuanced policies and translate them into training and evaluation criteria, helping models navigate high-stakes scenarios while preserving their usefulness and capabilities.

In this role, you’ll:

- Develop model policies that guide safe and useful behavior.

- Build evaluations, identify policy gaps and model failures, and use findings to improve policies and training.

- Work with research, engineering, and domain experts to support safe, reliable deployment.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Bring relevant experience in AI safety, policy, or risk assessment.

- Have strong judgment and can turn complex safety questions into clear, practical policies.

- Have the technical fluency to work hands-on with model data and evaluations.

- Are motivated by OpenAI’s mission and the responsible use of AI in safety-critical settings.

Security Requirements

Candidates must be eligible and willing to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. An active clearance is not required at the time of hire, and OpenAI will sponsor the clearance process.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Venture Capital AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from venture capital, from seed to growth stage, who build cap tables, round models and exit waterfalls in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the modelling work of a Venture Capital Associate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in venture capital, startup finance or venture law, covering seed to growth-stage rounds

- Deep hands-on Excel: cap tables, SAFE and note conversions, liquidation preferences, nested formulas and named ranges

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.

This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. WHAT YOU'LL DO

WHO YOU ARE

- 4-7+ years running B2B events in a fast-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.

- You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

In this role, you’ll build the infrastructure and manage the daily operations behind SpaceXSI’s global community programs. You’ll architect internal tools and automate workflows across our community initiatives, using the latest development tools to help the team work more efficiently. This role will be pivotal in giving our community team the backbone it needs to scale significantly in 2027.

What you’ll do

- Design, build, and maintain internal tooling and infrastructure that makes our global community programs run more effectively. This includes our Ambassador programs, student programs, and net-new programs.

- Identify operational gaps and engineer solutions, automating manual processes, integrating external platforms, and building custom workflows from scratch.

- Own the operational experience behind programs from application reviews, onboarding, member support, reimbursements, swag logistics, vendor coordination, and event operations.

- Work with the Revenue Operations team to build the data infrastructure and dashboards behind community reporting, connecting program data to company-wide tools to track ROI and conversions.

- Serve as the main operational point of contact for ambassadors and internal partners to increase time towards resolution on outstanding issues and questions.

You may be a fit if

- Deep operations experience in building databases, workflows, and automations that scale, and you design them for the next 10x, not just today.

- Experience managing vendors, budgets, and event operations globally, including the realities of time zones, currencies, international shipping, and local regulations.

- Strong bias toward action and would rather ship an 80% solution today than wait for perfect. We need someone that can make an impact on day one.

- You care deeply about community and understand the importance of building strong relationships with our champions. Ultimately, your work will free up our team to spend more time connecting with our community.

- Thrive in ambiguity and are energized by greenfield problems. You’ll be an early hire on a rapidly growing team.

- Fluency with the following tools: Cursor, Databricks, Luma, Slack, Notion, Salesforce, CRM and Clay.

title: Research Intern, ClickHouse Labs
description:
PROGRAM OVERVIEW

The ClickHouse PhD Research Internship Program offers doctoral students the opportunity to pursue ambitious research alongside ClickHouse Labs researchers and engineers working on some of the most interesting challenges in databases, systems, and data infrastructure.

Research interns join ClickHouse Labs for approximately 10-12 weeks to explore meaningful research questions, develop new ideas, and investigate technologies that have the potential to advance both the broader research community and the future of ClickHouse.

The program is intentionally designed around research collaboration. Interns are paired with experienced researchers and have the opportunity to pursue work that aligns with their academic interests, ongoing research, and areas of interest within ClickHouse Labs. In some cases, an internship may build on research, a prototype, or a system the student has already begun exploring at their university.

We believe the strongest research relationships extend beyond a single summer. Interns may continue their work after returning to their university through academic research, open-source contributions, publications, or other forms of collaboration. Where there is a strong mutual fit, an internship may become the beginning of a longer-term relationship between the researcher, ClickHouse Labs, and the broader academic community.

During their internship, researchers will have the opportunity to work closely with ClickHouse Labs, engage with ClickHouse's open-source technology and engineering community, share their findings, and contribute to the intellectual life of the broader research community.

Program length: 10-12 weeks, with flexibility based on academic calendars and research needs

Typical timing: Summer, beginning approximately June 1

Locations: Opportunities available across the US and Europe, subject to role and employment requirements. Remote first.

Research environment: ClickHouse Labs

Internship format: Research-focused, mentor-supported, and shaped around areas of mutual research interest

Compensation: commensurate with experience, a monthly stipend will be paid

RESEARCH AT CLICKHOUSE LABS

ClickHouse Labs explores ambitious ideas at the intersection of databases, distributed systems, data infrastructure, and the broader systems research community.

We believe some of the most interesting advances in these areas happen through close collaboration between industry and academia. ClickHouse Labs brings together researchers and engineers to explore new ideas, investigate challenging technical problems, and connect academic research with real-world systems at scale.

Research interns are an important part of that community. Interns have the opportunity to bring their own research interests and perspectives into ClickHouse Labs while working alongside researchers and engineers who are deeply engaged with both the practical challenges and open research questions shaping the future of data systems.

PROGRAM GOALS

1. Identify exceptional PhD researchers working in areas directly relevant to ClickHouse.

2. Give researchers the opportunity to work on meaningful, open-ended problems with ClickHouse Labs.

3. Build long-term relationships with researchers and academic institutions.

4. Encourage continued research and open-source contributions after the internship.

5. Create opportunities for co-authored papers, thesis advising, or other academic collaboration.

6. Increase ClickHouse's visibility within the database and systems research community.

7. Publish and share meaningful research outcomes through the ClickHouse website and other appropriate channels.

title: Data/ML engineer, fusion data
description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement. Responsibilities Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets. Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection. Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team. Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels. Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data. Requirements Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr). Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.</

title: Real Estate Sales Agent
description:
Real Estate Sales Agent
The voice that turns a quiet client database into real conversations about buying or selling.
Sector
Real Estate - US-based.
Reports to
Real Estate Agent
Type
Full-time
Hours
Full overlap with Pacific Time required
Rate
$4-$6/hr USD - DOE
Location
Fully remote
Tools
Contact list (previously used Follow Up Boss and RealGeeks), email, SMS/text platform, Facebook, Instagram
Role Overview
This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach - generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.
Key Responsibilities
Database Outreach & Reactivation

• Send emails and text messages to contacts in the client's database to reopen the conversation about buying or selling

• Track outreach activity: who was contacted, who responded, and who needs follow-up

• Personalize outreach based on each contact's history (past client, old lead, referral)

Social Media Outreach

• Reach out to relevant contacts via Facebook and Instagram messages

• Identify and engage people showing buying or selling signals on social platforms

• Keep messaging warm and personal - this is relationship reactivation, not cold advertising

Lead Qualification & Handoff

• Identify when a contact shows genuine interest in buying or selling

• Log conversation context clearly so the agents can pick it up without missing anything

• Hand off qualified conversations promptly so momentum isn't lost

Tracking & Reporting

• Keep a simple, current record of outreach activity and responses

• Flag which messages get replies and which contacts are warming up

Who Will Succeed
This role is steady, repetitive, and relationship-driven. The person who thrives here doesn't get discouraged by silence or 'no' - they stay warm, consistent, and genuinely curious about people.

• You're comfortable with repetitive outreach and don't take non-responses personally

• You write and message in a natural, warm tone - never scripted or salesy

• You're organized - nothing you send or hear back goes untracked

• You're comfortable on social media and know how to message people without feeling like a stranger

• You use AI tools to draft and personalize outreach faster, without losing the human touch

• You know the difference between generating interest and closing a deal - and you're energized by the first part

Experience & Skills

•
Required: Some familiarity with real estate concepts (buying/selling process, what a lead or database contact looks like) - not necessarily an expert

•
Required: Some experience with outreach, ISA (inside sales), or lead generation work - cold or warm outreach experience counts

•
Required: Strong written English - emails, texts, and DMs represent the client directly; writing is assessed at screening

•
Required: AI expertise - genuinely skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for drafting, personalizing, and speeding up outreach; this is a real capability, not casual use, and will be assessed

•
Required: Full overlap with Pacific Time required - not partial coordination

•
Required: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

-Preferred: Prior experience with a real estate CRM or database system
-Preferred: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

Wir generieren für über 500 Handwerksbetriebe und Küchenstudios im D-A-CH-Raum täglich Anfragen über Social Media. Unser Callcenter ruft diese Interessenten an und qualifiziert sie vor. 2. Coachen: Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Call-Reviews und Feedback im Team.

• Direkter Draht: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Produktionsleitung. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

• Fixgehalt + Prämienmodell: Planbares Fixum und Prämie bei Zielerreichung.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Selbst telefonieren: Du rufst Interessenten an, qualifizierst sie und machst dem Team vor, wie es geht.

• Coachen: Du führst Call-Reviews durch, gibst Feedback und arbeitest neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein.

• Mitaufbauen: Du hilfst beim Ausbau des Teams, inklusive Bewerbungsgesprächen.

Requirements
Das bringst du mit:

• Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst: oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle mit viel Kundenkontakt am Telefon.

• Schlagfertigkeit & Energie: Du bist am Telefon souverän, positiv und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus dem Konzept bringen.

Keine Führungserfahrung? Kein Problem. Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst, um ein Team gut zu führen.

Regulatory Awareness

title: Junior UX Designer
description:

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™ .
We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. • B2B cooperation for independent contractors.

If you’re energized by fast-moving environments, creative challenges, and work that genuinely moves the needle, you’ll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

Retention drives a SaaS business, and we’re looking for an experienced renewals professional to own it. As our Renewal Specialist, you’ll manage the full renewal lifecycle across a book of AIQ customers, from early outreach and risk identification through negotiation and signature. You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales, and Finance, and you’ll have a real voice in shaping how AIQ approaches renewals as we scale.

This role is for a seasoned renewals professional who knows what a healthy renewal motion looks like and is ready to bring that expertise to a growing team.

What You’ll Do

• Own renewals end to end for an assigned book of accounts, initiating outreach 90-120 days before term end, preparing quotes, and driving contracts to on-time signature.

Success in this role is measured by how well you retain and grow AIQ’s revenue, and how reliably you execute. Key measures include:

• Revenue retention: Gross and net revenue retention across your book

• Renewal rate: The share of renewals closed on time, before term end

• Expansion: Upsell and cross-sell revenue closed during the renewal window

• Forecast accuracy: How closely your renewal forecast matches actual results

• Execution: Timely outreach, accurate quotes and contracts, and a current HubSpot pipeline

• Proven churn mitigation experience, including identifying at-risk accounts early and turning them around.

• The ability to multithread across customer organizations and get to the decision makers who own the renewal.

About Ardent
Ardent Global Logistics is an international freight forwarding and customs brokerage company headquartered in Virginia Beach, Virginia. We move ocean and air freight, clear customs, and handle the trade compliance work behind both for small and mid-sized importers and exporters; the companies the largest forwarders tend to overlook.
Our mission is to enable our customers' business by doing common things in an uncommon way, benefiting everyone we serve.
That sentence is not wall art. We open every Monday morning meeting by reading it out loud, naming one of our culture values, and sharing wins from the week before. The last section of this description explains how we actually work; it matters as much as the bullets above it. Position Summary
The Account Manager owns a portfolio of Ardent accounts operationally and commercially. You are the person the customer calls, and the person Pricing, Operations, and Customs look to for the answer on what that customer expects. You keep rates current, quotes moving, SOPs accurate, and service consistent; and when something goes sideways, you are the one who gets in front of it before the customer has to ask.
This is not a pure sales role and it is not a service desk. You will exercise independent judgment on live accounts and you will execute detailed, process-driven work with your own hands. The people who do well here are comfortable doing both in the same day. What You Will Own
Account ownership and relationships

• Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts, owning day-to-day communication and the quality of every response

• Bring pricing options and recommendations to account leadership with the analysis behind them

• Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts into additional services and modes: ocean, air, customs brokerage, drayage, First Sale valuation, and duty recovery

• Identify at-risk accounts early and escalate them with a plan attached, not just a warning

Operational execution and SOP integrity

• Spot-check shipments for SOP compliance; flag recurring customer issues and gaps in the SOPs themselves

• Work with the Customer Experience team to write, maintain, and update customer SOPs and internal documentation so that what we promised is what we do

• Collaborate across Pricing, Operations, Imports, Exports, and Customs to resolve issues and protect service quality

• Maintain and update the preferred agent database so origin partner selection is a decision rather than a guess

• Keep account activity, contacts, and opportunities documented accurately and consistently in GoFreight and HubSpot

Performance, reporting, and business reviews

• Establish and monitor service standards and KPIs with assigned accounts

• Prepare and support quarterly business reviews and other customer-facing materials

• Monitor service quality, identify trends, and bring them to management review with root cause attached, not just symptoms

title: Lead Change, Release and Deployment Analyst

The Change Enablement Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for supporting the daily execution, consistency, and quality of the enterprise Change Enablement process. The Lead provides operational direction to Change Managers, oversees assigned work and service levels, performs complex change reviews, and serves as an escalation point for questions involving policy, risk, implementation readiness, and governance requirements.

This role requires strong knowledge of Change Enablement practices and ServiceNow. The Lead helps translate leadership direction into consistent daily execution, strengthens team capability through coaching and knowledge sharing, and provides management with visibility into workload, quality, risks, and operational concerns.
